arxiv-2107-14435.title: Chiral modes near exceptional points in symmetry broken H1 photonic crystal cavities
arxiv-2107-14435.creator: C. F. Fong, Y. Ota, Y. Arakawa, S. Iwamoto, Y. K. Kato
arxiv-2107-14435.description: Abstract The H1 photonic crystal cavity supports two degenerate dipole modes of orthogonal linear polarization which could give rise to circularly polarized fields when driven with a π \pi / 2 2 phase difference. However, fabrication errors tend to break the symmetry of the cavity which lifts the degeneracy of the modes, rendering the cavity unsuitable for supporting circular polarization.

arxiv-2111-13361.title: Geometric Multimodal Deep Learning with Multi-Scaled Graph Wavelet Convolutional Network
arxiv-2111-13361.creator: Maysam Behmanesh, Peyman Adibi, Mohammad Saeed Ehsani, and Jocelyn Chanussot
arxiv-2111-13361.description: Abstract Multimodal data provide complementary information of a natural phenomenon by integrating data from various domains with very different statistical properties. Capturing the intra-modality and cross-modality information of multimodal data is the essential capability of multimodal learning methods. The geometry-aware data analysis approaches provide these capabilities by implicitly representing data in various modalities based on their geometric underlying structures.

arxiv-2303-13256.creator: Liye Guo, Deivid Vale
arxiv-2303-13256.description: Abstract Time complexity in rewriting is naturally understood as the number of steps needed to reduce terms to normal forms. Establishing complexity bounds to this measure is a well-known problem in the rewriting community. A vast majority of techniques to find such bounds consist of modifying termination proofs in order to recover complexity information.

arxiv-2406-00852.title: Tikhonov regularization of monotone operator flows not only ensures strong convergence of the trajectories but also speeds up the vanishing of the residuals
arxiv-2406-00852.creator: Radu Ioan Boţ, Dang-Khoa Nguyen
arxiv-2406-00852.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Radu Ioan Boţ, Dang-Khoa Nguyen. In the framework of real Hilbert spaces, we investigate first-order dynamical systems governed by monotone and continuous operators. It has been established that for these systems, only the ergodic trajectory converges to a zero of the operator. A notable example is the counterclockwise π / 2 \pi/2 -rotation operator on ℝ 2 \mathbb{R}^{2} , which illustrates that, in general, trajectory convergence cannot be expected. However, trajectory convergence is assured for operators with the stronger property of cocoercivity.

arxiv-2410-14562.title: Chains of magnetic ions in NH + 4 {}_{4}^{+} -intercalated vanadium pentoxide
arxiv-2410-14562.creator: Anna A. Anisimova, Yaroslav M. Plotnikov, Dmitry M. Korotin
arxiv-2410-14562.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Anna A. Anisimova, Yaroslav M. Plotnikov, Dmitry M. Korotin. We explore the electronic and magnetic properties of NH + 4 {}_{4}^{+} -intercalated vanadium pentoxide (NH + 4 {}_{4}^{+} -V 2 O 5 ), a material that has been identified as a promising cathode for aqueous zinc-ion batteries. Density Functional Theory (DFT) calculations incorporating the Hubbard U correction reveal that NH + 4 {}_{4}^{+} -V 2 O 5 is an antiferromagnetic insulator with an energy gap of 1.97 eV.

pmc-12588262.title: Drivers of canyon incision in the Peruvian Andes: Tectonics, precipitation, and drainage basin capture
pmc-12588262.creator: Jennie Plasterr, Nadine McQuarrie, Eitan Shelef, Sarah Falkowski, Paul R. Eizenhöfer, Todd A. Ehlers
pmc-12588262.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The drivers behind the marked 2- to 3-km relief canyons carved into the ca. 3.7-km-high Andean Plateau remain debated, with proposed triggers ranging from plateau surface uplift to precipitation-enhanced erosion. We integrate a surface processes model with published cross-section–derived estimates of structural geometry, kinematics, and shortening rates, as well as precipitation estimates from global atmospheric circulation models, to assess whether the geometry, sequential fault motion, and resulting surface uplift can reproduce plateau morphology. Endorheic basins form where uplift on faults exceeds incision.

pmc-12790218.title: Eclipsed Severe Mitral Regurgitation Without Obstructive Coronary Artery Disease
pmc-12790218.creator: D.R. Tomassoni, T. Yeung, A.W. Teh, C. Ford
pmc-12790218.description: BackgroundIschemic secondary mitral regurgitation (MR) from left ventricular remodeling and geometric mitral valve changes is well recognized. Rarely, severe MR occurs with preserved left ventricular systolic function.Case SummaryA 70-year-old man presented with chest pain, global ischemic electrocardiography changes, and pulmonary congestion. During an anginal episode, transthoracic echocardiography revealed transient posterior-wall hypokinesis and torrential MR, both resolving as symptoms subsided.

pmc-13235778.title: Structure-functionality relationship of collagen-fibrin interpenetrating hydrogels for engineered tumor-stroma models
pmc-13235778.creator: Sae Rome Choi, Seamus M. Mellican, Tyler J. Roberts, Sehong Kang, Bennett D. Elzey, Hyunjoon Kong, Chelsea S. Davis, Melissa L. Fishel, Matthew J. Flick, Alisa S. Wolberg, Bumsoo Han
pmc-13235778.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Collagen and fibrin are two major extracellular matrix (ECM) proteins involved in tumorigenesis. During cancer progression, collagen and fibrin undergo sequential and concurrent polymerization and degradation, altering ECM structure and functional properties, which impact cell behavior and drug resistance. While engineered tumor models are recently emerging, including 3D printed tissue models and microphysiological systems (MPS), the interaction of these two proteins and its impact on the structure-functionality are largely overlooked.

Therefore, the present study evaluated the effects of foliar application of salicylic acid (SA) and silicon (Si) on the physiological, biochemical, and yield attributes of sorghum under saline conditions.
